purpose: Scalars that are assigned but must not appear in a storage name.
rule: A storage name MUST be rejected (STORAGE_NAME_UNSUPPORTED_SCALAR) if it contains any scalar in these ranges. This is checked before NFKC, on the input scalars.
rationale: Private Use is by definition a private agreement, so two clients have no guarantee of reading it the same way; it is unfit as collision-key material. Tags and the Variation Selectors Supplement are invisible and carry no naming intent.

not_excluded.U+FE00..U+FE0F: BMP variation selectors, including U+FE0F. IMEs insert U+FE0F automatically for emoji presentation; measurement found zero divergence for the whole emoji region. Excluding these would reject ordinary emoji folder names.

canonical_form: lines of '<START_HEX>..<END_HEX>', uppercase, no padding, LF separated, no trailing newline
